```{r}
my_data <- read.csv("air_data.csv")
head(my_data)
```

```{r}
summary(my_data[c("Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration", "Daily.AQI.Value", "Source")])
```
```{r}
my_data$CO_doubled <- my_data$Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration * 2
head(my_data[c("Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration", "CO_doubled")])
```
```{r}
hist(my_data$Daily.AQI.Value, main="AQI Distribution", xlab="AQI")
plot(my_data$Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration, my_data$Daily.AQI.Value, xlab="CO Concentration", ylab="AQI")
```
